title: R&M — Birdhurst: additional real sites/blocks found in the 762-row raw log (Phase 2 import prep)
notes: Wave 1 seeded 1 site (Birdhurst Packhouse) + 4 zones (Davies, Martins Block, Motueka Orchard, Strongs Block) from the Details sheet's 6 documented COMPANY rows - but missed Golden Bay Fruit/Birdhurst Sheds (GBF), and the Details sheet also has a separate FAMILY section (Reese and Andrea's home, Sue Wilkins' home) under an explicit 'NEW CONTRACT for residential security' note that was not previously captured. Exporting the full 762-row 2025 sheet and counting real (dated) Site-code frequency also found 2 more real MOT-coded sub-places not in the Details table at all: Central Rd (20 rows) and a covert camera at Staples St (6 rows, described as 'Birdhurst - Staples St Covert').

Confirmed MOT is NOT one physical place - it is shared by Motueka Orchard, Birdhurst Packhouse, Martins Block, Central Rd, AND Staples St, disambiguated only by free-text Location. The zone-map therefore intentionally has NO 'MOT' key; each real place is matched via its own Location-text variants instead (13 of 79 MOT rows have no Location text at all and are correctly left unresolved rather than guessed).
R&M's own internal admin rows (N/A/BASE, ALL, ALLF - all low volume) deliberately left unmapped, same pattern as PVT/M&R.
